# Vexlo — Websites That Deliver Leads for UK Small Businesses

## About
Vexlo builds websites for UK small businesses that are engineered to generate leads — SEO architecture from day one, instant quote calculators, online booking systems, and consistent business listings across 55+ high-authority UK directories. Once the leads arrive, Vexlo's AI layer captures every one: missed call text-back within 4 seconds, automated appointment booking, and Google review requests after every job.

Real client results: Tenanclean (end of tenancy cleaning, London) and Fyrup (passive fire protection, London) both saw their first organic leads around 2 months after their Vexlo-built websites launched, with lead flow compounding since.

No contracts. No setup fees on automation services.

## Core Services
- Lead-generating website design & development (SEO-driven, built to rank and convert)
- Custom quote calculators (visitors price their own job and book online)
- Online booking systems with automatic email confirmations for customer and owner
- Software integrations (Simpro, CRMs, calendars) and bespoke admin modules
- Business listings management across 55+ UK directories (NAP consistency for local SEO)
- Missed call text-back (AI responds within 4 seconds, 24/7)
- Automated appointment booking (self-booking link via SMS)
- Google review request automation (sent after every completed job)
- Real-time lead notifications and full dashboard

## Who We Serve
Vexlo is built for UK small businesses that want their website to actually produce enquiries:
- Businesses whose current website generates no leads
- Businesses with no website that rely entirely on word of mouth
- Cleaning companies
- Fire protection and compliance firms
- Roofers, plumbers, electricians, kitchen fitters
- Dental practices, salons and barbers
- Estate agents, physiotherapy and wellness clinics
- Property maintenance businesses
- Any trade or service business that wants leads from Google
